title: Zonal MIS Analytics Executive - South
description:
**Job Purpose**
 To work as an important link between Marketing Function (for all domestic markets and some international markets like Nepal \& Bangladesh) and Logistics Department so as to facilitate movement of goods in the most cost effective manner and on OTIF (On\-time, In\-Full) principle.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
* With the launch of multiple products, the movement of goods has become a challenging task in the Unit, more\-so in the context of higher no. of SKUs. The challenge gets multiplied with the dynamics and uncertainties of competitive market conditions wherein, the logistics \& dispatch plans are not static in a given period.
* The uncertainties arising out of external factors (like change in fuel prices, local logistical advantages of competitors in specific markets, troughs \& crests in monthly off\-take of Stockists linked to ongoing market\-demand, road transporters strike, impact of seasonality on availability of adequate means of transportation etc.) lead to daily fine\-tuning of dispatch plan and coordination with various internal customers/ external agencies so that the Monthly/ Quarterly/ Yearly Sales target are met.
* Also, the coordination task with relevant All\-India offices of CONCOR (tasks like rake\-planning \& transhipment planning, control of financial liabilities arising out of damages/ ground\-rents/ penalties/ demurrages, maintaining cordial relations with key\-decision\-makers and staff in CONCOR \& Indian Railways etc.), demands dedicated focus and highly effective coordination \& interpersonal skills.Key Challenges
* Uncertain market conditions impacting the variables of transportation/ movement of goods.
* To coordinate with All\-India marketing team and ensure maintenance of Optimum Stock Level in all the Depots, to avoid a stock\-out position, even in the most uncertain situations.
* Manage On\-Time, In\-Full delivery of all the SKU (Stock\-keeping Units) with a constant review \& control of \- dispatch plan, transit\-time in shipment of goods, damages, withheld material at Container Yards etc.
* Effective coordination with all the internal/ external touch\-points so as to maintain high level of customer satisfaction, especially on the parameter of OTIF Delivery.
* To streamline daily dispatch plan in a manner that it doesnt affect the monthly/ quarterly/ yearly sales target of Marketing\-function.
* To assist Marketing Head in preparing near\-accurate monthly sales budget of the entire product\-mix so that the production\-planning \& logistics\-planning are well aligned and deviations are minimized.


**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 Accountability: ASSISTANCE IN SALES PLANNING 1\. Study the historic trends of Sales (Month\-wise, Product\-wise, Sales Area\-wise, State\-wise, Zone\-wise \& All\-India for BW as well as competitors).
   

  

* Design formats to obtain the Sales Figure from Regional


 teams, during Planning \& Budgeting exercise.
   

  

* Coordinate with Regional teams to obtain their respective


 plans and compile the same to obtain All\-India picture.
   

  

* Assist Marketing Strategy Cell and Functional Head\-Marketing to streamline the forecasted Sales Plan, during Planning \& Budgeting exercise, (in accordance with the Revenue Driver Tree), so that the same can be converted into a systematic Dispatch \& Production schedule for a given FY.


 KRA2 COORDINATION FOR DISPATCH PLANNING 1\. Coordinate with regional teams to review, monitor and control the Dispatch Plan (on daily\> weekly\>monthly basis).
   

  

* Update the Sales\-Area/ State/ Region\-wise dispatch plan and submit the same through structured reports, to Functional Head\-Marketing. In other words, assist Functional Head (Marketing) in Reviewing and Controlling the Targets on a daily basis, set for a given FY.
* Based on the daily review with FH (Mktg.), prepare a status report, as per the amendments finalized in discussion with FH.
* Provide timely information about the amendments \& status reports to all concerned Regional/ State/ Sales Area Heads, to ensure that the Dispatch Planning is in tandem with the decisions.


 KRA3 CUSTOMER SATISFACTION CUSTOMER SATISFACTION
   

  

* Ensure timely dispatch of material, as per Customers plan, through daily follow\-up \& coordination with Logistics (Kharia)
* In pro\-active coordination with the concerned sales team, ensure that the Optimum Stock Level in the Depots (Godowns) is maintained so that the Customer at these locations doesnt face a stock\-out position.
* To interact with dis\-satisfied Customers (Stockists \& Industrial buyers), in the event of delays in delivery of material. Accordingly, handle their grudges/ complaints in a manner that such situation crisis does not have a bearing on their relationship with the Organistaion.
* Serve as an important central link between Logistics (Kharia) and Regional teams to facilitate the OTIF (On\-time, In\-Full) delivery of goods.


 KRA4 COORDINATION WITH CONTAINER CORPORATION OF INDIA (CONCOR) 1\. Coordinate with all relevant offices of CONCOR, on All\-India basis, for timely rake planning and trans\-shipment planning on daily basis.
   

  

* Maintain cordial relationship with key\-decision\-makers and staff in CONCOR to control financial liabilities arising out of damages, ground\-rents, penalties/ demurrages, withheld containers etc.
* Facilitate the negotiations between Logistics (Kharia) and CONCOR, thus contributing in cost\-effective transportation of goods.
* Ensure timely placement of rakes at Works\-Kharia.


 KRA5 INTERFACE BETWEEN CMO \& LOGISTICS (KHARIA) INTERFACE BETWEEN CMO \& LOGISTICS (KHARIA)
   

  

* Prepare and submit All\-India ¿Order transmission plan¿ to Logistics (Kharia) on daily/ weekly basis.
* Based on competitor¿s dispatch information received from Logistic (Kharia) and relevant State Heads, prepare reports related to State\-wise dispatches of all Brands of White Cement, on monthly basis. These reports are used by all Departments for analysis of Industry Growth, BW Growth and Market\-share of all the brands.
* Facilitate meetings and execution of specific tasks with CONCOR, based on directions/ requirements of Logistics (Kharia).
* Facilitate information\-based interaction between FH\-Marketing and Logistics (Kharia), through various informative reports (generated as per the requirements of FH\-marketing). Such reports provide a basis for taking decisions related to Sales/ dispatches/ logistics related affairs and also serve as an informative base for various analytical tasks carried\-out by marketing Strategy Cell (during Planning \& Budgeting Exercise and Quarterly reviews).

title: Engineer II - Analytics & Insights
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Business Intelligence Developer
   

  

 The Business Intelligence Developer is responsible for designing and developing dashboards and reporting solutions using the Microsoft BI stack, with a strong emphasis on Microsoft SSRS/Snowflake and SQL development. This role focuses on building scalable data models, managing data and report development and enhancements, and supporting production\-ready analytics solutions in an Agile environment.
   

  

 You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to translate data into actionable reporting and insights, while contributing to the full development lifecycle—from data sourcing and modeling to visualization and optimization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Write and optimize complex SQL queries to support reporting and analytics in the SSRS and Snowflake platforms
* Translate business and client requests into applicable technical deliverables
* Build and maintain data models using relational databases, tabular models, or cubes
* Develop proof\-of\-concept (POC) reports and dashboards and evolve them into production solutions
* Ensure data accuracy, performance, and scalability of BI solutions
* Collaborate with technical teams to define and implement data structures and reporting schemas
* Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning and delivery
* Support testing, validation, and ongoing enhancement of dashboards and reports
* Research and apply new tools, features, and best practices in BI and data visualization


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 3–5\+ years of experience in BI or data development roles
* Strong expertise in:
* SQL (advanced querying, performance tuning)
* Microsoft SQL Server (SSRS)
* Experience working with:
* Experience with Snowflake or other cloud data platforms
* Data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling
* Familiarity with Sigma or other modern BI tools (Tableau, Looker, etc.)
* Ability to work with large datasets and optimize performance
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


 Nice\-to\-Have Skills (or willingness to learn)
   

  

* Exposure to CI/CD, Git, or DevOps practices
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly
* Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively
* Eagerness to learn new tools and technologies


 Work environment:
   

  

* Willingness to occasionally work outside of normal business hours as required to complete projects
* Sitting at desk or in meetings for long periods of time
* Use standard office equipment


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

**Join us!**
**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**

**Position Overview**
 The Team Execution Lead, Data \& Analytics is responsible for driving delivery execution across Zelis Data \& Analytics teams supporting one or more corporate functions, including ZEDI, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Legal, Finance, and People \& Culture.
   

  

 This role is a modern evolution of the Scrum Master role, with greater emphasis on delivery accountability, continuous planning, dependency management, stakeholder alignment, and execution against committed timelines. The Team Execution Lead helps Data \& Analytics teams remain focused, organized, and predictable while enabling the incremental delivery of trusted data products, analytics capabilities, and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 The role supports teams working across the Zelis data ecosystem, including the Snowflake data platform and Sigma analytics front end, as well as related data pipelines, models, integrations, dashboards, and reporting solutions. The Team Execution Lead partners closely with Data Product Managers, Data Engineering and Analytics leaders, Data Architects, Data Governance, business stakeholders, and source\-system teams to translate functional priorities into actionable delivery plans.
   

  

 The Team Execution Lead is not expected to serve as the primary data architect, engineer, or analyst but must possess sufficient technical fluency to understand data solution designs, challenge assumptions, identify delivery risks, and coordinate work across complex data and business dependencies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong Agile and/or hybrid delivery experience, practical knowledge of modern data and analytics delivery, and the ability to build trusted partnerships across technical teams and corporate functions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead day\-to\-day delivery execution for Data \& Analytics teams supporting assigned corporate functions and enterprise priorities.
* Support continuous planning and delivery by helping teams manage intake, clarify business value, refine priorities, sequence work, and adjust plans as needs evolve.
* Partner with Data Product Managers, Data Engineering and Analytics leaders, Data Architects, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to translate roadmap priorities into actionable delivery plans.
* Facilitate delivery routines, including planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, dependency reviews, retrospectives, stakeholder updates, demonstrations, and release\-readiness discussions.
* Maintain clear visibility into deliverables, milestones, risks, blockers, dependencies, capacity constraints, assumptions, and decisions needed.
* Drive accountability for committed work by ensuring owners, timelines, acceptance criteria, data requirements, dependencies, and next steps are clearly understood.
* Coordinate dependencies across Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Governance, Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, AI and Automation, and corporate\-function teams.
* Help teams break down complex data and analytics initiatives into manageable increments that can be developed, validated, released, adopted, and measured.
* Support delivery of Snowflake\-based data products, including ingestion pipelines, integrations, transformations, data models, governed datasets, data marts, and platform enhancements.
* Support delivery of Sigma dashboards, workbooks, reports, semantic content, and self\-service analytics experiences that enable timely and informed business decisions.
* Ensure delivery plans account for source\-system readiness, data availability, business definitions, data quality, lineage, access controls, privacy, testing, validation, deployment, user adoption, and operational support.
* Identify and escalate risks related to scope, capacity, data quality, source\-system dependencies, integration complexity, technical readiness, security, governance, stakeholder availability, and timeline impacts.
* Partner with technical leaders to ensure data solutions align with architecture standards, platform patterns, security requirements, governance policies, and long\-term maintainability expectations.
* Support testing and validation by coordinating technical testing, data reconciliation, business acceptance, production readiness, release communications, and operational handoff.
* Help teams balance urgent reporting and analytics needs with sustainable engineering practices, reusable data products, governed definitions, and scalable platform standards.
* Use delivery metrics such as throughput, cycle time, aging work, blocker trends, predictability, dependency health, and delivery confidence to improve execution.
* Provide transparent communication to stakeholders regarding delivery status, risks, trade\-offs, decisions, scope changes, and timeline impacts.
* Promote team effectiveness by removing impediments, improving delivery flow, reducing unnecessary process overhead, and keeping teams focused on the highest\-value outcomes.
* Encourage responsible use of AI\-enabled delivery practices, including backlog analysis, documentation support, meeting summaries, risk identification, delivery insights, data\-quality analysis, and workflow improvement.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of ZEDI delivery practices, standards, tools, and communities of practice.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Professional Experience/Qualifications**
* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master, Delivery Lead, Project Manager, Program Coordinator, or related technology delivery role.
* Experience supporting data platforms, data engineering teams, analytics teams, business intelligence capabilities, reporting solutions, or data\-product organizations strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of modern data and analytics concepts, including data ingestion, transformation, integration, data modeling, semantic layers, dashboards, reporting, data quality, testing, and production readiness.
* Experience managing deliverables to timelines in a complex, cross\-functional technology environment.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, hybrid delivery, traditional/waterfall, and/or continuous planning and delivery models.
* Strong understanding of backlog management, dependency management, risk management, delivery planning, capacity planning, stakeholder communication, and release coordination.
* Familiarity with data\-governance concepts, including data ownership, stewardship, lineage, metadata, classification, access, privacy, retention, and quality management.
* Ability to understand data requirements, business rules, key performance indicators, calculations, source\-to\-target relationships, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar tools to manage work, track delivery progress, document decisions, and communicate status.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and translate complex delivery issues into clear business terms.
* Experience supporting corporate functions such as Finance, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Legal, People \& Culture, or enterprise technology is a plus.
* Experience supporting cloud data platforms; practical knowledge of Snowflake is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting business intelligence, visualization, or self\-service analytics platforms; practical knowledge of Sigma is preferred.
* Experience working in healthcare technology, regulated environments, or enterprise shared services is a plus.
* Agile, Scrum, SAFe, PMP, or related certifications are a plus.


**Leadership Requirements Include**
* Strong delivery leader with a bias toward execution, accountability, transparency, and measurable outcomes.
* Servant leader who supports team effectiveness while creating structure, focus, and follow\-through.
* Comfortable leading without authority in a highly matrixed organization.
* Able to build trust with Product, Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Architecture, Security, Governance, AI/Automation, and business stakeholders.
* Strong facilitator who can drive alignment, surface risks, resolve ambiguity, and keep teams moving.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including stakeholder\-facing delivery updates.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to anticipate blockers, manage dependencies, and escalate effectively.
* Growth mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, AI\-first ways of working, and delivery maturity.
* Ability to balance collaboration and team empowerment with the discipline required to deliver committed outcomes on time.

title: Health Economics Associate- Advanced Analytics
description:
**Key Accountabilities**
 The Associate contributes statistical capabilities and methodological support at all stages of real\-world data analytics projects, working with data sources such as electronic health records (EHR), claims data, and registry data to generate insights and support evidence generation. The role works under the supervision of an experienced team member in designing, developing, and delivering client solutions across multiple projects, leveraging competencies in statistical analysis, interpretation, and study design.
   

  

**Project Execution**
* Acting as support biostatistician or statistical programmer to interact with the study team and the sponsor
* Support in drafting statistical sections of protocols, performing sample size and power calculation for studies.
* Supporting in reviewing data management plans, data specifications, and other related study documents
* Supporting in developing statistical analysis plans
* Contributing to the preparation of specifications for analysis datasets
* Supporting in developing statistical programs to generate listings, tables and figures as outlined by a statistical analysis plan
* Performing QC of TLFs and other analysis datasets
* Providing statistical input to Clinical Study Reports
* To help ensure quality standards are adhered to on all projects and new methodologies and techniques are adequately assessed and implemented.
* To help foster thought leadership opportunities.


**Skills**
* Ability to manage priorities to meet multiple and sometimes competing deadlines.
* Excellent scientific, business writing, and presentation skills with attention to detail.
* Exceptional communication skills, especially in the relaying of technical information and project concepts.
* Competent in written and spoken English
* SAS, R, SQL, and/or Python


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 2\-4 yrs of experience with familiarity in healthcare consulting or pharmaceutical organizations.
* Experience working with large real\-world databases such as electronic health records (EHR), claims data, and national registries is highly preferred
* Strong basis in fundamental statistical concepts and methods and familiarity with techniques such as development of predictive equations, survival analysis (including parametric methods), longitudinal data analysis, meta\-analysis, mixed treatment comparison, and other hierarchical analysis techniques, etc.

title: Master Data Governance
description:
SGS is the world's leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 94,000 employees, we operate a network of more than 2,600 offices and laboratories around the world. We provide the world’s most comprehensive range of integrated inspection, testing, certification and advisory services, powered by the latest technology and digital tools.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* Create, update, and maintain
 **customer and supplier** 
 master data accurately and consistently across approved finance and business applications.
* Review master data creation and modification requests to ensure completeness, accuracy, supporting documentation, and required approvals.
* Validate key data fields including legal names, trade licenses, VAT details, bank details, payment terms, contact information, customer account classifications, supplier categories, and related compliance documentation.
* Perform duplicate checks, inactive account reviews, data cleansing, and exception analysis to improve customer and supplier master data quality across systems.
* Use system reports, Excel, and basic SQL queries where available to extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze master data records and identify gaps, inconsistencies, or unauthorized changes.
* Maintain a structured archive of master data requests, approvals, supporting documents, change logs, and audit trails for audit and management review.
* Monitor master data workflows, follow up on pending approvals, and ensure requests are completed within agreed turnaround times.
* Generate data extracts, exception reports, quality checks, and periodic validation reports to monitor data completeness, duplication, consistency, and compliance gaps.
* Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, Sales, Operations, IT, system owners, and relevant data owners to resolve incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent master data.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, data governance standards, segregation of duties, delegation of authority, and audit requirements.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization, automation initiatives, and stronger master data governance across customer and vendor data processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field.
* 4 years of relevant experience in master data management, customer data management, supplier data management, finance operations, ERP data administration, or business application data support.
* Hands\-on experience maintaining customer and vendor master data in ERP or business applications.
* Good understanding of customer and supplier master data processes, approval workflows, data governance, documentation requirements, segregation of duties, and internal controls.
* Working knowledge of SQL for basic data extraction, validation, duplicate checks, exception reporting, and reconciliation would be a strong advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, conditional checks, reconciliations, exception reports, and structured data reviews.
* Exposure to Power BI, workflow tools, data quality tools, MDM tools, automation platforms, or system implementation projects would be an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and data quality discipline.
* Good analytical, reporting, reconciliation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work with structured datasets, identify inconsistencies, perform root\-cause checks, and recommend corrective actions.
* Practical understanding of ERP master data fields, customer and vendor account structures, approval workflows, change control, and audit trail requirements.
* Ability to follow procedures, maintain complete documentation, and meet processing deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Business Analyst Quality Control Solutions- Setlab
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst Quality Control Solutions \- Setlab to join the Manufacturing \& Quality Technology organization and play a key role in delivering Sandoz's Digital Quality Strategy. In this role, you will partner with global Quality Control, Manufacturing, and Technology stakeholders to analyse business processes, define system requirements, and drive the implementation and continuous improvement of QC laboratory solutions, including LIMS, CDS, LabX, and related platforms. You will lead requirements gathering, process modelling, system validation, and deployment activities while ensuring compliance with GxP, CSV, and regulatory standards. The successful candidate will combine strong business analysis capabilities with deep knowledge of quality and laboratory systems to deliver innovative, data\-driven solutions that enhance operational efficiency, support global quality processes, and enable business transformation across a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights\-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient\-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry\-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
   

  

 Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions
* Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation
* Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy
* Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance
* Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost\-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements
* Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations
* Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users
* Lead business analysis activities for medium to large\-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels
* Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies
* Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with advanced facilitation and presentation capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences
* Strong leadership capabilities including team mentoring, project coordination, decision\-making, and the ability to influence without authority
* Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical industry, or regulated environments with deep understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* A patient\-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 7 years of business analysis experience, with at least 3 years in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering and process improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* Experience with clinical systems implementation and configuration (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, etc.)
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical research (GCP, ICH, FDA, EMA)
* Experience with Agile and traditional software development methodologies
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, life sciences, or related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), IIBA certifications, or PMI\-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis)
* Training in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Background in implementing or optimizing clinical data management processes
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and facilitating decision\-making


 We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
   

  

 If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Global Head SAP BW and Analytics Platforms
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This role is accountable for shaping and delivering the global SAP BW and Analytics strategy, ensuring scalable, secure, and high\-performing data platforms that enable enterprise\-wide decision\-making and digital transformation.
   

  

 The Global Lead drives end\-to\-end ownership of solution architecture, demand governance, and vendor execution to deliver measurable business value from SAP analytics investments. This leadership role plays a critical part in enabling S/4HANA transformation and ensuring consistent, high\-quality analytics capabilities across regions and functions.
   

  

 The role provides strategic and visionary leadership for the SAP BW and Analytics domain by shaping the future\-state roadmap, governance model, SAP CoE alignment, investment priorities and budget discipline. It ensures that data, analytics and reporting capabilities are not only stable and compliant, but also positioned as strategic enablers for simplification, standardization, innovation, transformation readiness and measurable business value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**Major Accountabilities**
**Strategy, Roadmap and Business Value**
* Define and deliver the global SAP BW and Analytics strategy and roadmap, aligned with enterprise data, ERP and digital transformation priorities.
* Ensure SAP analytics investments are prioritized and delivered against clear business outcomes, value realization and enterprise\-wide adoption.
* Translate complex business needs into scalable analytics capabilities and continuous process improvements that strengthen decision\-making across functions and regions.


**Solution Architecture and Platform Excellence**
* Own end\-to\-end lifecycle accountability for SAP analytics platforms, from solution concept and design through delivery, optimization and continuous improvement.
* Support \& implement architectural direction and governance to ensure scalable, secure, compliant and future\-ready solutions across BW/4HANA and the broader analytics ecosystem.
* Enable successful integration with S/4HANA and related enterprise systems, ensuring consistent, reliable and high\-performing analytics capabilities.


**Data Governance, Risk and Operational Reliability**
* Establish and enforce data management, integration and interoperability standards that support trusted, consistent and reusable analytics across systems.
* Drive risk management, platform performance, reliability and security outcomes for global analytics platforms.
* Ensure demand, delivery and operational governance support stable BAU performance, transformation programs and M\&A integration requirements.


**Vendor, Delivery and Team Leadership**
* Lead the vendor ecosystem and delivery governance to secure high\-quality outcomes across projects, services and transformation initiatives.
* Build and lead a high\-performing global team of Solution Engineers and Solution Owners, strengthening accountability, collaboration and innovation.
* Create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and partnership with business and Technology stakeholders.
* Create executive\-level visibility through roadmap narratives, decision papers, governance dashboards, risk insights and value realisation updates that support senior leadership decisions.
* Shape portfolio choices and architectural direction by balancing business agility, regulatory expectations, operational stability, cyber and application security, technical debt reduction and total cost of ownership.
* Provide a forward\-looking point of view on future SAP BW and Analytics capabilities, simplification, standardisation, automation, integration, data quality and innovation opportunities.
* Define and continuously evolve the multi\-year SAP BW and Analytics strategy and roadmap in alignment with enterprise SAP strategy, S/4HANA transformation priorities, SAP CoE direction and business value objectives.


**Strategic and Visionary Leadership**
* Identify cost optimisation and value realisation opportunities across licenses, services, vendors, solution design, delivery models and operating practices.
* Prioritise demand and investments based on strategic fit, SAP roadmap alignment, business value, compliance needs, risk reduction, capacity and affordability.
* Partner with Finance, Procurement and vendor management to ensure SOWs, invoices, purchase orders, accruals and cost allocations are transparent, accurate and aligned with approved scope and business value.
* Own budget planning, forecasting and financial governance for the SAP BW and Analytics portfolio, including change, project, vendor and transformation spend where applicable.


**Investment Prioritisation and Value Realisation**
* Contribute to SAP CoE capability building by coaching Solution Owners, Solution Engineers and partner teams on governance expectations, decision quality and value\-led delivery.
* Drive cross\-domain alignment with other SAP platform leads to manage dependencies, integration risks, master data impacts, release priorities and transformation sequencing.
* Translate SAP CoE principles into practical delivery guardrails, reusable patterns, quality gates and operating routines for projects, enhancements and BAU services.
* Represent the SAP BW and Analytics domain in SAP CoE governance forums, ensuring that domain roadmaps, architecture decisions, delivery standards and risk positions are transparent and aligned with the broader SAP strategy


**SAP CoE Governance and Cross\-Domain Leadership**
* SAP BW and Analytics strategy and roadmap approved through SAP CoE governance and progressed against agreed milestones, priorities and value outcomes.
* SAP CoE standards, architecture guardrails, methodology and governance routines adopted consistently across the domain portfolio.
* Budget performance managed against approved plan, including forecast accuracy, cost transparency, SOW and invoice governance, and timely escalation of financial risks.
* Portfolio prioritisation decisions demonstrably aligned to SAP strategy, business value, compliance, risk reduction, capacity and affordability.
* Strategic risks, architectural dependencies, technical debt and transformation readiness items identified early, governed transparently and managed through active mitigation plans.
* Value realisation from SAP investments tracked through business outcomes, simplification, standardisation, adoption, service quality and measurable improvement actions.
* Cross\-domain collaboration effectiveness within the SAP CoE, including dependency management, reusable design patterns, shared standards and timely decisions


**Minimum Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
